mapper.select: SELECT rp.role_id, p.perm_id, p.action_cd FROM tb_role_permission rp JOIN tb_permission p ON p.perm_id = rp.perm_id WHERE p.menu_id = #{menuId}
SELECT role_id FROM tb_admin_role WHERE admin_id = #{adminId}
SELECT admin_id, login_id, admin_nm FROM tb_admin WHERE admin_id = #{adminId}

SELECT p.menu_id, p.action_cd, r.role_nm FROM tb_admin_role ar JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = ar.role_id AND r.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN tb_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.role_id JOIN tb_permission p ON p.perm_id = rp.perm_id JOIN tb_menu m ON m.menu_id = p.menu_id AND m.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tb_menu p1 ON p1.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu p2 ON p2.menu_id = p1.parent_menu_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND coalesce(p1.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND coalesce(p2.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY r.role_id
